newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: PRESS DIGEST - New Zealand newspapers - Apr 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New Zealand newspapers - Apr 28.

text.p: 'Horrific' road toll for the holiday: Observance of basic road safety rules would have prevented the "horrific" number of road deaths over the holiday weekend.
CBD hoping to raise $29.5m: Auckland-based property investor CBD NZ hopes to raise between $19.5 million and $29.5 million through an issue of $1 shares.
